property_summary: For any caller and any deposited amount, C.withdrawAll succeeds (does not revert) and transfers funds out (so address(c).balance decreases accordingly); the mutant that replaces the external call with require(false) causes withdrawAll to revert for callers who have positive credit, breaking this rule for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace the external call with a revert by requiring false, preventing transfers and changing observable behavior.
